sources.rights_notes: The official table defines 6-84 as Structural- and ornamental-metal workers. The category identifies neither an employer, workplace, specific trade, nor the sequence from Army service to OSS; the historical wording is preserved.

affiliations.date_precision: Civilian-occupation value 684 was recorded at Army entry on March 1, 1942. NARA's code table defines 6-84 as Structural- and ornamental-metal workers; no employer, workplace, or specific trade is identified.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier and full name confirm the Army identity. The historical occupational group is not converted into a named employer, immediate-OSS affiliation, workplace, or narrower trade.

claims.claim_text: Irvin P Davis has an unresolved private-identifier/full-name conflict.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact private identifier printed in the OSS index returns an Army entry with a wholly different full name; a separate exact-name Army row carries another identifier.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The identifier and name evidence conflict; neither Army record is assigned to the indexed person.
claims.temporal_assessment: The identifier-selected Army row is dated October 21, 1943, but none of its occupation or biographical fields is accepted for Irvin P Davis.
claims.match_notes: The full identifier and unrelated subject's identity remain private. Box 170 and the original Army record require review.

claims.claim_text: The OSS index and Army merged file identify the same James M Davis.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The private identifier and exact name agree across the two official NARA records.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by the exact private identifier and full-name match.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army row records entry on March 1, 1942, as private.
claims.match_notes: The private value is withheld publicly. Eighty-six other exact-name Army rows carry different identifiers and remain unassigned.

claims.claim_text: James M Davis's Army-entry record classifies the prior civilian occupation as structural- and ornamental-metal worker.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The identifier-matched Army row carries value 684; NARA's official code list defines 6-84 as structural- and ornamental-metal workers.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed exact private-identifier and name match.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded at Army entry on March 1, 1942; no employer, workplace, or specific trade is identified.
claims.match_notes: The historical occupational group is not converted into a named employer, immediate-OSS affiliation, workplace, or narrower trade.
